hero.title: We Are Africa.
hero.lead: Possibilities Africa (PA) is a Christian ministry organization dedicated to equipping pastors in rural African communities with the knowledge, skills, and attitude necessary to conduct holistic transformation ministries.
hero.imageAlt: Local church leader teaching from an open book with community members seated under open sky

whoWeAre.title: Nehemiah's approach.
whoWeAre.lead: Our philosophy of ministry is rooted in the story and work of Nehemiah in the Bible.
points: Our philosophy of ministry is rooted in the story and work of Nehemiah in the Bible.
Just as Nehemiah worked diligently with his fellow countrymen to rebuild the broken walls of Jerusalem so that they would not live in disgrace (Nehemiah 2:17-18),

Possibilities Africa works with people in each community to mobilise them to rebuild the broken walls of their society, spiritually, socio-economically, physically/materially, and culturally so that they may live dignified lives.

vision.label: Our Vision
vision.text: To see spiritual, mental, socio-economic, cultural transformation of lives in rural African villages

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.text: Possibilities Africa (PA) is a Christian ministry organization dedicated to equipping pastors in rural African communities with the knowledge, skills, and attitude necessary to conduct holistic transformation ministries.

items.title: Holistic Faith
items.text: We believe that the Bible is God's word and it provides all that man requires for life and godliness.

items.title: Servant Leadership
items.text: We encourage a culture of service to others using one's time, talents and treasures.

items.title: Personal Responsibility
items.text: We inspire people to take personal responsibility for the change they desire to see

items.title: Vision
items.text: We teach that people without vision perish. African villages should create a vision of what they are building for the future generations.

items.title: Community
items.text: We affirm that when people join hands in unity they are able to achieve a collective Vision that improves their lives.

items.title: Stewardship
items.text: We teach people that all they are, have and that is around them is God's resources entrusted to them to be managed well for God's glory and man's wellbeing.

items.title: Productivity
items.text: We challenge people to live industrious lives.

people.name: Martin Simiyu
people.bio: "We can change the cycle of dependence to create a new way of life that empowers Africans to build and create the lives they desire."

countries.title: Seven countries on the network.
countries.lead: We work as one ministry with churches, partners, and communities across seven countries.

history.title: PA History.
history.lead: From a single missionary's burden to a continental movement.
history.roots: During a mission trip to Kenya with a group of students and faculty from Moody Graduate School USA, Martin shared his desire to return to Africa to help poor communities. PA embarked on a major focus to market holistic approach by initiating training programs for pastors to build their capacity to do holistic ministry.

milestones.title: Ideation, Learning & Discovery Season
milestones.text: During a mission trip to Kenya with a group of students and faculty from Moody Graduate School USA, Martin shared his desire to return to Africa to help poor communities.

milestones.title: Mission Acceptance & Expansion Season
milestones.text: PA embarked on a major focus to market holistic approach by initiating training programs for pastors to build their capacity to do holistic ministry. This effort led to PA presence in 13 communities in Kenya, Malawi, and Rwanda.

milestones.title: Evaluation, Reorganization & Repositioning Season
milestones.text: PA ministry officers undertook a “Know Your Client” survey which revealed that not everyone in our program was properly motivated and committed. From this survey, a new baseline was established.

milestones.title: Vision 2030 Initiated
milestones.text: Setting a new growth agenda, PA has undertaken a major holistic programs review with a vision to establish 20 new countries of operation in strategic locations in Africa.
